title: MK-style 2.5D fighter HELLKICK made entirely in Godot 4.7 and its biggest update just shipped
author: HellkickDev
selftext:
HELLKICK is a gory arcade fighter (think MK with divekicks) built in Godot 4.7 with GDScript. The campaign descends through the nine circles of Hell, and we just shipped Circle IV: GREED, where every fighter wears a jetpack and the arenas are built vertical: crushing coin presses, a wrecking ball, an auctioneer who sells whoever stands still, and a two-act boss that brings the whole cave down on him.

Online and local multiplayer enabled. This specific level (in the video) is unapologetically an ode to one of the biggest Ai Artists in the art space, Claire Silver ([https://x.com/clairesilver](https://x.com/clairesilver)). Why? I got fed up of the tree-hugging anti-ai crowd and felt like pissing them off by including an amazing highly respected artist in my own game.

The playtest is free on Steam if you want to try it, and I'm happy to answer any engine or architecture questions in the comments.

Steam Page:  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4922820/Hellkick/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4922820/Hellkick/)

replies.author: HellkickDev
replies.body: Hahaha it’s a proper rage game 🤣

replies.author: Motorcycle_Madness
replies.body:
I also loved the fatality kick, I love to look at these demos. My friend always wanted to make games but he didn’t have the time or energy to learn C# for unity and now idea -> prompt -> game is possible. 

I’m very anti ai for a number of reasons but the creativity here is cool.

replies.author: HellkickDev
replies.body: Thanks so much, appreciate your honesty. You’re the kind of anti ai person i’d love to hang out with 🫂

replies.author: HellkickDev
replies.body: "slop is in the eye of the beholder"

replies.author: HellkickDev
replies.body: you be the judge if it's slop or not.  As I said in the post, the specific arena is an ode to one of the biggest AI artists. Everybody and their cat are trying hard to avoid showing they used any sort of AI in developing their game - I am not. I have used some collaborative AI. If that makes the game 'slop', as you said, then so be it.

replies.body:
Dont think it's the ai part, more that it feels like slop.

You can do good stuff with ai, if you want.

replies.author: HellkickDev
replies.body: Will certainly improve the game. It’s in early playtest phase. For now i’m exploring the concept.
